issues.evidence: The enlarged Changes panel has visibly soft lettering at 00:52.5 and 01:04.5. Measured sharpness is 29.9 at 51.2 and 14.5 at 63.2.
issues.suggested_action: Recapture the real panel at higher resolution with increased application zoom, then frame it at native pixel scale.

issues.evidence: The memo's sentences run beyond frame-right, and the FY26 outlook table column and its revenue value are cut off.
issues.suggested_action: Pull back to include the full paragraph and outlook column, then make a separate close insert of the tracked replacement.

issues.evidence: Dark interface frames cut to nearly full-frame white documents; measured mean luma rises from 28.2 to 229.7, and later from 44.5 to 234.5.
issues.suggested_action: Contain the genuine document captures within a consistent dark surround and reduce paper-white intensity while preserving text contrast.

issues.evidence: The prompt is enlarged into blurred text spanning most of the frame, with a yellow rectangle, a quoted caption and a second caption stacked below.
issues.suggested_action: Capture the prompt sharply at readable application zoom, retain one highlight and place one caption in a reserved lower margin.

issues.evidence: The ribbon occupies much of the upper frame, empty spreadsheet columns fill the bottom, and 'Accept all' is clipped at frame-right.
issues.suggested_action: Reframe around the complete diff bar and affected cell, reducing ribbon and empty-grid coverage.

issues.evidence: Cards, messages and application windows sit front-on against a dark gradient; separation comes mostly from outlines rather than spatial depth.
issues.suggested_action: Introduce restrained layer depth, consistent contact shadows and a subtle motivated screen glow while keeping text planes frontal and readable.

issues.evidence: David's face is evenly filled against bright windows, with less cheek shadow and separation than Maya's night-office coverage.
issues.suggested_action: Use window-side key with negative fill on the opposite cheek and lower background exposure to restore facial shape.

issues.evidence: The 9-second shot is represented by successive tight panel crops at 00:55.5, 00:58.5 and 01:01.5; sampled frames cannot establish smooth movement or natural motion blur.
issues.suggested_action: Verify playback for stepping or abrupt crop changes; if present, replace them with one eased vertical move that settles on each selected diff.

constraint_failures.evidence: The memo paragraph and FY26 outlook column extend beyond frame-right, hiding part of the displayed content.
